MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  MONDAY, AUGUST 7, 2023

A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
order by CHAIR YOO at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

VICE CHAIR MEDAWAR led those assembled in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Yoo, Medawar, Olson, Romanelli, Schachter

  Commissioners Absent:  Nicklas

  City Staff Present:  Jeannie Naughton, Community Development Director
  Katrina Kawagoe, Assistant Planner
  Carol Corea, Administrative Analyst

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES, JULY 10, 2023.

VICE CHAIR MEDAWAR made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES FOR THE MEETING OF JULY
  10, 2023.

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

NONE

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

COMMISSIONER OLSON made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR MEDAWAR to,

  APPROVE ITEM 6A

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

NONE

8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-230046; LOCATION: 2215 POTRILLO ROAD,
  ROLLING HILLS ESTATES, CA 90274; APPLICANT: DAMARIS BAILEY; A request for a
  Neighborhood Compatibility Determination (NC-230047) for the 389 square-foot single-
  story addition to the front face of an existing single-family residence and a new 94 square-
  foot attached patio cover projected into the north-facing side yard. A Variance (V-230048)
  is required for the encroachment of the front-facing addition into the required front yard
  projecting past the forwardmost building line and a Minor Deviation (MD-230049) for the
  reduction of the front yard by no more than 10%.

Assistant Planner Kawagoe stated that staff was informed by the applicant that the portion of their
project that required the above entitlements is being removed from the scope of work. Staff
requested written confirmation of this request, but it has not been received as of the time of this
meeting.

Staff recommends that this item be continued to the next Planning Commission meeting
scheduled for Tuesday, September 5.

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
MINUTES, AUGUST 7, 2023
  1
 COMMISSIONER OLSON made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI to,

  CONTINUE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-230046  TO  THE  PLANNING
  COMMISSION MEETING ON SEPTEMBER 5, 2023.

AYES:  Yoo, Medawar, Olson, Romanelli, Schachter
NOES:
ABSENT:  Nicklas
ABSTAIN:

9.  COMMISSIONER ITEMS

VICE CHAIR MEDAWAR asked about the overgrown vegetation on Crenshaw Blvd. Director
Naughton stated that she will discuss this with the Public Works Director to make contact with LA
County to address this. The overgrown vegetation is primarily between Silver Spur Road and
Palos Verdes Drive North. VICE CHAIR MEDAWAR stated that he appreciates the abatement
that was done on Silver Spur Road.

VICE CHAIR MEDAWAR inquired about street sweeping on Silver Spur Road and stated that
there are embers from a traffic collision at the intersection of Beechgate that is still there. Director
Naughton noted this as well.

10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

Director Naughton introduced Katrina Kawagoe, Assistant Planner. She has been with the City
as the Planning Intern and recently accepted the position of Assistant Planner.

11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS - JUNE 27, 2023

B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS – JULY 11, 2023

VICE CHAIR MEDAWAR made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEMS 11A – 11B.

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

12.  ADJOURNMENT

At 7:06 p.m., CHAIR YOO adjourned the Planning Commission meeting to the next Adjourned
Planning Commission meeting scheduled for Tuesday, September 5, 2023 at 7:00 p.m.in the City
Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates.

Respectfully submitted by,  Approved,

Carol Corea, Administrative Analyst  Victor Yoo, Chair
